about_the_game:
A hintbook and lorebook document that will help you immerse yourself in the world of Metahorror Therapy Session!

This will give you access to Metahorror Therapy Session's 40-page Hintbook & Lorebook, a two-for-one deal that includes:

  • A spoiler-free hintbook that will help you in your sessions with Noel, offering hints and guides on how to get all endings, viewing secret content, and unlocking special modes.

  • A lorebook delving the world and characters of the game. Perfect for quick referencing and catching some details that you might've missed while delving into the world of Metahorror. Also includes new details on its setting, fun facts on characters, and some behind-the-scenes secrets.

How to view the document

Access the game's installation folder in your steamapps/common folder. You'll find another folder called 'Metahorror Digital Extras' - that's where the .pdf file is!

You can open it on your phone, computer, or tablet. Have fun!
